name: @sonofg0tham/quell-claude
description: Claude Code plugin: blocks prompts that contain secrets (UserPromptSubmit) and asks before a tool call reads a secret and sends it over the network (PreToolUse).

scripts.bundle-scanner: cd ../scanner && npm run build && cd ../claude-plugin && node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('../scanner/dist').filter(f => /\.(js|d\.ts)$/.test(f)).forEach(f => require('fs').copyFileSync('../scanner/dist/'+f, 'scanner/'+f))"
scripts.test: node test/redact.test.js && node test/pretooluse.test.js && node test/posttooluse.test.js

author: Craig McCart
